name: Hammer curl

phases.name: curl
phases.cue: Curl up, thumbs to the ceiling

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower slowly until your arms are long

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Palms in, elbows by your sides

formTips: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides
Keep your thumbs up and wrists straight the whole rep
Pin your elbows by your sides; only your forearms move
Curl up towards your shoulders, then lower slowly until your arms are long
commonMistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight
Turning the palms up, which makes it a regular curl
Dropping the dumbbells instead of lowering them
